clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, human priests seek a prayer for their own hour of need. At the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena teaches acolytes to call on the Holy Light when their lives are at risk.

Priests in the Cathedral of Light learn to use their faith to shield companions, heal wounds, and strike at evil. Yet even the devout can be isolated, cornered, or brought close to death. In such moments, an acolyte may cry out to the Holy Light for help, with their own survival at stake.

High Priestess Laurena guides clergy in Stormwind's Cathedral Square and judges when an acolyte is ready for deeper teachings. Human initiates who show devotion to the Light across the kingdom receive this lesson as both protection and a charge to continue serving the realm.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done the Light a great service by becoming a shining example to those who travel in these dangerous lands and beyond. Please, accept this lesson as a thanks for all you've done.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
